sentences.en: To facilitate the operation the braves wore long war-locks or scalping-tufts, as an implied challenge.

sentences.en: McGinley also had a lot more of the ball & his telling crosses were asking questions of the Braves ' defense.

sentences.en: After hosting the 1996 Olympics, the population skyrocketed to 4.1 million residents who enjoy the Botantical Garden, Museum of Art, World of Coca-Cola, Atlanta Braves, and yoga!
